title: Pump Operators, Except Wellhead Pumpers
description: Tend, control, or operate power-driven, stationary, or portable pumps and manifold systems to transfer gases, oil, other liquids, slurries, or powdered materials to and from various vessels and processes.

tasks.text: Monitor gauges and flowmeters and inspect equipment to ensure that tank levels, temperatures, chemical amounts, and pressures are at specified levels, reporting abnormalities as necessary.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Reporting malfunctions is structured information relay

dwas.name: Monitor equipment gauges or displays to ensure proper operation.
Report vehicle or equipment malfunctions.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Record operating data such as products and quantities pumped, stocks used, gauging results, and operating times.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Record production data into structured logs

tasks.text: Plan movement of products through lines to processing, storage, and shipping units, using knowledge of interconnections and capacities of pipelines, valve manifolds, pumps, and tankage.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Operational planning drafted; execution accountability human

tasks.text: Turn valves and start pumps to start or regulate flows of substances such as gases, liquids, slurries, or powdered materials.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical control of pumping equipment

tasks.text: Communicate with other workers, using signals, radios, or telephones, to start and stop flows of materials or substances.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Material-handling coordination tied to physical operations

dwas.name: Communicate with others to coordinate material handling or movement.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Connect hoses and pipelines to pumps and vessels prior to material transfer, using hand tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Connecting hoses requires physical fitting

dwas.name: Connect hoses to equipment or machinery.

tasks.text: Tend vessels that store substances such as gases, liquids, slurries, or powdered materials, checking levels of substances by using calibrated rods or by reading mercury gauges and tank charts.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Monitoring cargo conditions is physical/sensor-based

dwas.name: Measure the level or depth of water or other liquids.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Clean, lubricate, and repair pumps and vessels, using hand tools and equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Machinery cleaning requires hands-on work

dwas.name: Maintain material moving equipment in good working condition.

tasks.text: Read operating schedules or instructions or receive verbal orders to determine amounts to be pumped.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Parse work orders into procedures reliably

dwas.name: Review work orders or schedules to determine operations or procedures.
Receive information or instructions for performing work assignments.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Test materials and solutions, using testing equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Testing samples requires lab hands-on work

tasks.text: Tend auxiliary equipment such as water treatment and refrigeration units, and heat exchangers.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Sensor/vision monitoring possible, but physical verification and accountability remain human

dwas.name: Monitor equipment operation to ensure proper functioning.

tasks.text: Add chemicals and solutions to tanks to ensure that specifications are met.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on loading of processing equipment

dwas.name: Load materials into equipment for processing.

tasks.text: Collect and deliver sample solutions for laboratory analysis.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual moving of materials and supplies

dwas.name: Collect samples for analysis or testing.

tasks.text: Pump two or more materials into one tank to blend mixtures.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical control of pumping equipment
